items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And Norman gave me one of those albums, and I thought it came out very well.

ctx.x: Now, Ben loved Hawk, just like he was his father, and he said, "Can we book a date for tomorrow?" Norman said, "Yes." And we went up to 50th and Broadway and Ben went to the phone booth and called Budd Johnson. He says, "I think I'm going to rock the boat a little bit and bring Budd in." And you should have heard the -- I guess Norman still has
those tapes. The conversation on there was tremendous.
